prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Personality Preview Grid: Redesign the pick friend screen into a stage layout where users can preview live pet animations, sound effects, and unique personality traits before making their selection. (why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate in the funnel at 60.9% conversion and a high mean duration of 1017s. Giving users dynamic visual feedback makes pet selection faster and more engaging.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Screen: Insert a desktop preview check screen right after asset generation to test overlay rendering and display permissions before taking the pet home. (why: Support logs show 3 users reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling, while the home waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Dual-Track Instant vs Custom Pet Flow: Introduce a clear split between instant instant-ready preset pets and custom photo pet creation with live validation status. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or visual glitches, contributing to the severe 60.9% drop-off at the adoption step.)
3: [home, wait_info] Live Creation Progress & Tip Carousel: Enhance the waiting screen with real-time asset compilation milestones and automated desktop shortcut tips. (why: Median waiting time is 201 seconds with a mean of 2336 seconds, causing users to abandon the app before reaching the desktop.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Assistant for Custom Pets: Provide dynamic clear/blurry photo feedback hints on the photo upload screen before custom pet processing begins. (why: 3 support messages cited custom pet creation failure or poor visual quality during adoption setup.)
5: [finish, layout] Split Desktop Intro & Companion Showcase: Change the home intro layout to a split spotlight frame showing the pet sitting directly on the user's taskbar. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 19.1%, with a drop at finish (64.8% step conversion); visual clarity around taskbar behavior reduces friction.)
